description: Source code for Twilio Media Streams WebSocket protocol serializer in Pipecat, handling audio and DTMF events, call termination, and WebSocket message serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: TwilioFrameSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for Twilio Media Streams WebSocket protocol, converting frames to/from WebSocket messages, handling call hang-up, and audio encoding/decoding.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the serializer with Twilio credentials, stream and call identifiers, and configuration parameters.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the serializer with pipeline input sample rate from the StartFrame.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Converts Pipecat frames into Twilio WebSocket messages, handling media, interruption, and call hang-up.

methods.name: _hang_up_call
methods.description: Uses Twilio REST API to terminate the call via HTTP request.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts incoming Twilio WebSocket messages into Pipecat frames, handling media and DTMF events.
